title: Vibe coded a Mercenary Company Autobattler roguelike prototype, sharing my learnings and also seeking gameplay feedback
author: WeAreFictional
selftext:
For the past 2.5 weeks, I've been vibe coding an Auto-battler roguelike game. I've uploaded to itch and I'd like to seek your playtest feedback if you're into auto-battlers.  
  
**Itch-io link**  
[https://dannylimanseta.itch.io/banners-will-fall](https://dannylimanseta.itch.io/banners-will-fall)

This one's been a lot of fun to build, and I'd love to hear what you think. Currently desktop browsers only, so grab your laptop and give it a go!

**My Vibe Coding Stack:**  
For this game, I used Cursor to build it with Godot engine, I'm pleasantly surprised how good Opus 4.6, GPT5.3 is at Godot vibe coding, and I didnt have to use any MCP server or touch the Godot Game Editor other than previewing/exporting the game or copying error messages.

I had to vibe code a custom art generation tool (using Google Nano Banana) to generate most of the art assets for the game. Though I still had to use photoshop to manually edit some of the art assets to clean it up and resize proportions.

Hope you like it!

comments.author: thelyonna
comments.body:
It’s a nice game, congrats!  
I have a couple of pieces of feedback:

* It’d be nice to have a female face option for characters with obviously female names (though it *is* funny to have a bearded guy named Isadora on my team XD).
* There should be an option to skip the animation on the contract results screen. For example, if I click the end card, it should immediately show the loot and everything, without having to wait for the text to finish appearing.
* When comparing equipment, it’d be nice to see a summary of the attribute differences between the two items (e.g., -2 health, +3 skill power, etc.). Alternatively, up/down arrows next to stats to show which item is better would make quick comparisons easier.
* When comparing equipment, there should be a small icon indicating which item is currently equipped. (I know the bottom item is the equipped one, but it can still be confusing sometimes.)
* If there’s an ambush when I try to heal, I should heal at least partially before the ambush fight starts.
* There should be an option to buy back fallen mercenaries after they die in combat. (Maybe that’s what the locked cemetery location is for, but I figured it’s worth mentioning anyway.)

All in all, it’s a fun game with nice visuals!

replies.author: WeAreFictional
replies.body:
This is great feedback! Thank you for checking out the game. You’re right about the names not matching the faces and lack of female faces and I agree with the suggestions you made! I’ll consider them and explore some improvements.

And you’re right about the graveyard! I plan for a way to ‘revive’ fallen mercs for a fee but I haven’t figured out how best to implement that in a way that it trivialises a merc death. Thanks again for the wonderful suggestions and feedback!
